name: NetEase News Inspired
description: A NetEase-inspired GEOFlow frontend theme mapping portal home, health-style category lists, and article detail pages while preserving GEOFlow data contracts.
notes: Inspired by NetEase portal, NetEase Health channel, and NetEase article-page layout patterns. Does not copy NetEase assets, content, or proprietary code.
Keeps GEOFlow Blade variables, SEO meta fields, markdown HTML rendering, category navigation, footer, article routes, and optional article ad data intact.
Reference-only NetEase modules intentionally omitted: login, mailbox/register, app download widgets, comment/share widgets, large external ad slots, and unrelated image-heavy blocks.
